Selects one of Omarchy's bundled themes and renders it into every app config it drives.
omarchy-themes installs no packages: all 22 themes ship inside the `omarchy`
package at /usr/share/omarchy/themes, and the templates that project a theme
into per-app configuration ship beside them at
/usr/share/omarchy/default/themed. This candy's whole job is to APPLY one, by
running omarchy-theme-set in its headless mode so the selection is baked into
the image rather than left to first login. Verifiable on the built image: the
recorded theme name matches what was asked for, the current-theme link
resolves, and the rendered per-app configs exist.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | bake the selected Omarchy theme into the image |
| `check` | the applied theme content is the bundled theme that was recorded |
| `check` | the current-theme directory resolves to real theme content |
| `check` | the full bundled theme set is available to switch to at runtime |
| `check` | the theme-set command is on PATH for runtime switching |
